extDescription.message: On Google Scholar profiles: the profile owner's author role and the venue's CCF and CORE rank on each paper, counted in one table.

marksHint.message: From two sources: the words that authors write in a paper's title or venue line on Scholar (not checked), and a bundled list of award-winning papers at major conferences.

marksAsWritten.message: from the authors' own words or the award list

tipHidden.message: Scholar cut the author list, so the profile owner's position in it is not visible

coverHidden.message: $N1$ roles hidden by cut author lists

coverHiddenOne.message: 1 role hidden by a cut author list

resolveHint.message: Opens each paper's page on Scholar (about one per second) to read the full author list.

resolveHintSemantic.message: First asks Semantic Scholar for each paper's author list (it gets only the title). Then opens Scholar's page for the other papers, about one a second.

resolveCaptcha.message: Google asked for a CAPTCHA. Solve it in a normal tab, then try again.

coverAbsent.message: $N1$ papers where the profile owner's name is not in the author list

coverAbsentOne.message: 1 paper where the profile owner's name is not in the author list

coverUnmatched.message: $N1$ papers at venues without a rank

coverUnmatchedOne.message: 1 paper at a venue without a rank

layoutWarning.message: Scholar's page layout seems to have changed: this extension cannot read the author lines. Please report it.

variantsTitle.message: Name not matching? Add a spelling

variantAutoTip.message: Added automatically: your profile name in the other order finds you in $1 papers

variantSuggestTip.message: Appears in $1 papers whose author list does not otherwise name you — click to add this spelling

dataNote.message: Ranks come from today's $N1$ lists, not the rank at publication time. CCF states that its list is not a basis for academic evaluation.

noRanksNote.message: No venue on this profile is on the $N1$ lists, which cover computer science.

rulePrefix.message: Matched by the visible part of a cut name

tipToday.message: current list, not the rank at publication

popupNotProfile.message: Open a Google Scholar author profile to see its summary here.

optPreviewNote.message: Sample papers as they will look on a Scholar profile. “A Author” is you.

optRolesHint.message: Each role gets its own row colour. Papers where you are in the middle stay plain.

optMarkName.message: Mark my name in the author line

optMarkNameHint.message: Bold and tinted. Hover it to see your position.

optCopyHint.message: Which buttons copy or save the papers shown, or the summary, as text. The panel and the toolbar popup offer the same ones; with none on, there is no copy row.

optMarkAwardHint.message: Best, outstanding and distinguished paper, honorable mention, test of time, and best-paper finalists.

optPanelShowHint.message: The panel in the right-hand column of a profile page. Off: only the paper list is marked up.

optPanelSummaryHint.message: The table of your papers by role and rank, with the note on where the ranks come from.

optPanelMarksHint.message: The count of award-winning papers and talk kinds, one click to list them.

optPanelStatusHint.message: How many papers are loaded, the “Load all” button, what could not be read, and the list of papers at venues without a rank.

optPanelNamesHint.message: “Name not matching? Add a spelling” and the suggestions for your name.

optPanelCompact.message: Compact: filters and citation totals only

optPanelFiltersHint.message: The search box, the quick filters, the highlighted-only switch and the year range.

optPanelMetricsHint.message: Papers, citations, h-index and i10-index of the highlighted papers.

optCacheCount.message: $N1$ papers' author lists are saved on this device (kept for 90 days).

optCacheCountOne.message: 1 paper's author list is saved on this device (kept for 90 days).

optResetConfirm.message: Reset all of these settings to their defaults?

optStorage.message: Your settings stay in your browser and sync with your Chrome profile. The extension reads the Scholar pages that you open. When you press Read full lists, it also reads the pages of papers with a cut author list. Paper titles go to Semantic Scholar only if you turn that on.

optAutoLoadHint.message: Scholar shows only the first papers of a profile. This presses Scholar's own “Show more” button for you, about once a second, until the whole list is loaded. It stops if Scholar stops answering. Off: the panel shows “Load all” instead.

loadStalled.message: Scholar sent no more papers ($N1$ loaded). Try “Load all” again in a moment.

optHideHint.message: Hide parts of the profile page that repeat the panel or that you do not use. Nothing is hidden until you switch it on.

optHideCitedHint.message: The citations, h-index and i10-index table and its graph: the panel shows the same totals for the highlighted papers.

optHideCoHint.message: The list of co-authors in the sidebar.

optHideAccessHint.message: The public access box in the sidebar.

optMergeHint.message: Some profiles list one paper several times.

optMergeLabelHint.message: Entries with the same title and the same first author become one entry (capitals, accents and punctuation do not count). The most cited entry stays and shows the citations of all of them. The panel counts it once.

mergedTip.message: Merged from $N1$ entries: the citations of all of them

optLanguageHint.message: The language of this extension, and of the Scholar pages you open.

optLanguageScholarHint.message: A Scholar page you open in another language (a shared link, say) is opened again in this one.

optColorsHint.message: The colour of each author role: rows, name marks, the panel and the toolbar popup.

optContrastTip.message: Contrast of this colour with Scholar's white page. 3:1 or more keeps the row's bar visible.

optTalkRowsHint.message: How the talk kinds are counted. Together, a paper that has more than one of them counts once.

optSemanticHint.message: A second place to look for what Scholar cuts off.

optSemanticLabel.message: Read author lists from Semantic Scholar first

optSemanticLabelHint.message: When you press Read full lists, first ask Semantic Scholar for each paper's full author list. It gets the paper's title and nothing else. Scholar's own page is then opened only for the papers that Semantic Scholar does not know. Fewer requests to Scholar mean fewer CAPTCHAs.

optPanelYearsHint.message: A bar for each year, in the role colours.

optPanelVenuesHint.message: The ranked venues of your highlighted papers, most frequent first; click one to list its papers.

optCopyDiagnostics.message: Copy details for a bug report

optSemanticKeyHint.message: A free key from semanticscholar.org/product/api avoids the rate limit shared by everyone who has none. It stays on this device (not synced) and is sent only to Semantic Scholar.

resolveSemanticBusy.message: Semantic Scholar asked to slow down, so Scholar's own pages were used for the rest.

noRolesHint.message: No author role is switched on, so nothing is highlighted.

resolveSemanticKey.message: Semantic Scholar did not accept the API key, so Scholar's own pages were used for the rest.

optHideCitedTableHint.message: The citations, h-index and i10-index table in the sidebar.

optHideCitedChartHint.message: The yearly citation histogram in the sidebar.

optConfigHint.message: Settings as JSON: copy them, save them to a file, load a file, or paste a change into the editor. A preset changes only what it names, and the page says what it applied and what it ignored.

optConfigNothing.message: Nothing to change: the settings already say that.

optAgentHint.message: Copy a guide that lists every setting, its values and your current choices. Give it to your AI assistant with what you want. Then paste its answer into the configuration editor below, and press Apply configuration.

optCacheEmpty.message: No paper details have been saved on this device yet.

optChipsHint.message: The small labels after a paper's venue: its ranks, and awards or talks.

optPanelOrderHint.message: From top to bottom. A part that is switched off keeps its place.

optTableNote.message: Note on where the ranks come from

optFiltersKey.message: The “/” key jumps to the search

optFiltersKeyHint.message: In the panel on a profile, and on this page for its own search. Off: the key does nothing.

optMetricsScope.message: Line naming the roles that count

optStatusCutoff.message: Cut author lists, and Read full lists

optSaveFailed.message: Not saved: Chrome limits how often settings can be written. Wait a moment and change it again.

optNameTip.message: Your own name for this, in every language. Empty: the standard name.

optPreviewEdit.message: Hover a part to hide it (✕), move it (⠿) or find its setting (⚙). Double-click a name to rename it, anything else to jump to its setting.

optRenameHint.message: Enter keeps it · Esc cancels · empty: the standard name

optVenueHint.message: Paste a venue as Scholar prints it: the grey line under a paper. You see what the CCF and CORE lists make of it, and by which rule. A venue that they cannot place gets no rank. Nothing is guessed.

optVenuePlaceholder.message: e.g. Proceedings of the IEEE conference on computer vision and pattern recognition

optVenueNone.message: No rank. The lists do not place this text for certain, so it gets no chip.

optVenueSecondary.message: “$N1$” marks a secondary track, such as a workshop, a poster or a short paper. It gets no rank, unless the venue's own name has that word.

optSaveTooBig.message: Not saved: the names add up to more than Chrome's storage keeps for the settings (8 KB in all). Shorten some of them.

optFiltersFollowHint.message: The table, the award and talk counts and the copied summary count only the papers that the filters leave: a year range, a search, a quick filter or a venue. A selected cell or row does not change the counts. Off: they always count the whole profile.

filterAbsent.message: Name not in the author list

optCopySource.message: Add the profile's link and the day to the copied summary

optCopySourceHint.message: The copied summary and table end with a line that gives the profile's link and the date (Source: …), so that you can file or send the numbers. A list that is not fully loaded always says so there.

optPrefer.message: When both lists rank a venue

optPreferHint.message: One chip instead of two: the chip of the list that you pick, and the other list's chip only where the first list has no rank for the venue. The chip's tooltip still names the other rank.

ruleMine.message: Your own mapping (settings → Check a venue), not the list's rule

optMineAssign.message: Assign it to a listed venue…

optMinePick.message: Search the CCF and CORE lists: name or acronym

optMineNoMatch.message: No listed venue has these words.

optMineHint.message: Venue lines no rule ranks that you tied to a listed venue. Their chips are dashed, and copies mark their rank “(your mapping)”. They fill gaps only: a line the lists rank keeps the lists' rank.

coverMapped.message: $N1$ papers ranked by your own venue mappings

coverMappedOne.message: 1 paper ranked by your own venue mappings

optMineFull.message: Chrome keeps about fifty mappings: the $N1$ oldest were removed to make room.

optVenueCut.message: Scholar cut this line off (…), so it cannot be assigned: paste the venue's whole name from the paper's own page.

copyNotLoaded.message: Not fully loaded: $N1$ papers so far

optMineFullOne.message: Chrome keeps about fifty mappings: the oldest was removed to make room.

optVenueGeneric.message: This line names only a sponsor or a publisher, not a venue, so it cannot be assigned: a mapping of it would take every such line.
